title: Compatibility after top restriction source comparison
statement:
theorem standardSingleBaseChange_topRestriction_compatibility
    {Y B A : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ B) (M : Y.Modules) (g : A ⟶ B) :
    letI := fun X : Scheme.{u} ↦ HasDerivedCategory.standard
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    ∀ (e : (schemeDerivedDirectImage p).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj M) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι))),
      e = standardSingleBaseChange_topRestriction_sourceIso p M → ∃ (t : (schemeDerivedDirectImage
          (pullback.snd ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p) g)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj
              (pullback.fst ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p) g)
              (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι))) ≅
        (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd p g)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            (Scheme.Modules.tensorPullbackObj (pullback.fst p g) M))),
      standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g =
        (derivedPullback g).map e.hom ≫
          standardSingleBaseChangeMap ((⊤ : Y.Opens).ι ≫ p)
            (M.restrict (⊤ : Y.Opens).ι) g ≫ t.hom

proof.text: Substitute e. Construct the pullback apex isomorphism k explicitly using the lift with first coordinate r' ≫ j and the inverse lift with first coordinate r ≫ Y.topIso.inv. Pullback projection extensionality and the topIso inverse laws prove the inverse identities. The two lift projection equations give hr and hs.

Apply exists_openSingle_coefficient_transport with U=top to obtain the invertible coefficient comparison d and its equation. Construct F as Rs of the unit for k.hom, the canonical image-composition comparison, transport by hs, and Rs'.mapIso d. The unit is invertible by the existing iso pullback unit theorem.

Apply derivedBaseChange_source_transport to a (the precise open-single comparison used in sourceIso), q_r(M), q_r'(N), d and the coefficient equation. Its left side is standardSingleBaseChangeMap p M g followed by F.hom; its right side is Lg(sourceIso.hom) followed by the restricted standard map. Set t=F.symm, postcompose the equality by F.inv, and cancel F.hom followed by F.inv.

statement_change.what: The universal quantification over arbitrary source isomorphisms is false. The compatibility is required only when e is the constructed canonical source comparison, expressed by an implication.
